messages:
mira (PM): Quick 10m on post-GA iteration rules. We need a lightweight policy so eng and support know what is emergency vs next-sprint. Proposal: emergency = user-data loss, security, service outage, >20% sustained unit-cost regression affecting billing. Anything else funnels to the next mini-iteration, but we reserve a small carveout for customer-impactful asks.

alex (ENG): Agree with the emergency list. Two practical asks: (1) make sure the bug template asks for a reproduction and impact delta (latency/cost/customers affected), (2) define launch windows for hotfixes so infra can schedule deploys.

sofia (SRE): From reliability side: add error-rate spike + backend timeouts as emergency. Also propose a triage SLA: acknowledgment in 1hr, deploy target 24hrs for Sev-Critical, 72hrs for Sev-High. We'll need runbook updates.

rob (DS): For unit-cost regression, define the metric precisely. I suggest: >20% increase in 6h rolling median of cost-per-response for top 50 customers. I'll prototype an alert.

jen (PD): Customer asks: I want a tiny fast lane. If a customer request is nonblocking but blocks renewals for a paying account, it should be eligible for the fast lane. Limit: up to 15% of next mini-iteration capacity and require an impact statement + pre/post metric.

mira (PM): So updated rule: emergencies = {data loss, security, outage, timeouts, error spikes, >20% cost delta}. Fast lane = paying-account churn-risk items (max 15% capacity) with PRs for measurement. Everything else -> backlog.

alex (ENG): Implementation notes: create a "hotfix-yes/no" checkbox in the issue template and a simple triage checklist. Also tag PRs that touch runtime/model with must-canary label.

ops-bot: Canary deploy launched: canary/ga-hotfix-1720050000 -> 5% traffic. Monitors: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost.

sofia (SRE): On failure conditions: auto-rollback if error-rate rises >0.8% OR if p99 latency increases by >50% vs baseline in 15m window. We'll add the thresholds to the monitoring runbook.

rob (DS): I'll wire the cost alert to a dashboard and make it create an issue template if triggered. Can also add a short historical snapshot into the issue body.

jen (PD): I'll draft the fast-lane intake form: customer, ARR at risk, expected lift, metric to track. PD sign-off required.

mira (PM): Action list: Alex -> issue template + triage checklist by EOD. Rob -> cost alert prototype + dashboard link by Thu. Jen -> fast-lane intake draft by tomorrow. Sofia -> runbook SLA + rollback thresholds update. I'll collate into a short "Post-GA Hotfix Playbook" and post it in #product. Anyone object?

alex (ENG): No objections. I'll include a sample checklist: reproduction steps, customer impact, cost delta, suggested mitigation, canary plan.

sofia (SRE): I'll schedule a 15m oncall walkthrough for the new tags and rollout thresholds.

mira (PM): Thanks all. Posting the draft later today and we'll have a final 15m sync tomorrow to sign off. :raised_hands:
